captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.chained: In chains. Your captors leave you be while you keep your place. Striking anyone, breaking a block, opening a chest or working at the shackle where they can see is acting up, and the third time they put you to death.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.slip: Slip the shackle: at night, hold %1$s and stay perfectly still for a few seconds.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.pick: Pick the shackle: kneel (%1$s + scroll down, then hold still) and press %2$s with a lockpick in hand. It needs Lockpicking Prowess, unless you're a Thief. A stick and a rock make a crude lockpick.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.chain: Break the chain: kneel and press %2$s with a rock or flint in hand, again and again. Every slam is loud, and a captor near may hear it.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.rope: Saw through the rope: kneel and press %2$s with a blade, flint or shears in hand, again and again. A captor watching may see you at it.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.cell: In the cells. Wait out your time (it shows on the bar), or try the door. Dying won't get you out.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.cell_door: The cell door: press %2$s on it with coin in hand to pay the fine and walk out clean, or kneel and pick it with a lockpick.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.cell_out: Breaking out: pick the door or dig your way out, and you're free but an outlaw there. A forged writ shown to a guard may get you let out.
captive_tip.jaymoskingdoms.hogtied: Hogtied. Mash %1$s to work free of the knots. A punch from whoever holds you sets you back.
